d: Ministry of External Affairs Official Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal addressed reporters during a media briefing in New Delhi on bilateral, consular, and regional issues. Addressing the status of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue, Jaiswal affirmed that "India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh," adding that the next round of discussions will take place on a mutually convenient date to take up revised travel arrangements.
